# Yudaro AI & ERP Systems

Private AI, Odoo ERP implementation, AI + ERP integration and workflow automation. Based in Stafford, serving the Houston area, Texas and the United States.

Contact: 13366 Murphy Road, Stafford, TX 77477; +1-281-258-8000; info@yudaro.com.

## Services and guides
- [Private AI for Business: Implementation & Knowledge Search](https://yudaro.com/ai-solutions): Private AI implementation for company documents, SOPs and training. Plan permissions, deployment and costs with Yudaro in Houston and across Texas.

- [Odoo Data Migration & Cutover Planning](https://yudaro.com/solutions/odoo-migration): Plan Odoo migration with source mapping, trial imports, reconciliation, user acceptance and controlled cutover.
- [Odoo Integration & AI Connections](https://yudaro.com/solutions/odoo-integration): Connect Odoo with commerce, accounting, POS and private AI using scoped interfaces, permissions, reconciliation and monitored workflows.
- [Odoo Customization & Workflow Design](https://yudaro.com/solutions/odoo-customization): Evaluate Odoo configuration, extensions and custom modules with fit-gap analysis, testing and upgrade planning.
